name: box_creature
about: a creature of boxes on four legs: the test plan that goes the library's whole path, not an animal

shoulder_height.own: a test plan: no animal is measured; about a mid-sized dog's withers so its walk is of a familiar size

body_length.own: a test plan: a trunk a little longer than the creature is tall

leg_length.own: a test plan: legs a little over half the shoulder height

head_length.own: a test plan: a head's own spread, to test a residual on one number

build.own: a test plan: girths vary by six in a hundred

walk.source: Fr 0.25, below the walk-trot change at Fr about 0.5 (Alexander 1993, as quoted in research C2, Sources disagree 2)

trot.source: Fr 1.0, above the walk-trot change at Fr about 0.5 (Alexander 1993, as quoted in research C2, Sources disagree 2)
